title: Regularisation and Hyperparameter Search
learning_objectives: Regularise a linear model with Ridge and explain how alpha shrinks coefficients
Search hyperparameters with GridSearchCV over a pipeline
hints: Build the pipeline, then `GridSearchCV(pipe, {"ridge__alpha": list(alphas)}, cv=..., scoring=...)` and fit it.
`-search.cv_results_["mean_test_score"]` gives the MSE for every alpha in grid order.
For the norms, fit `make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=a))` on all data and take `np.linalg.norm(p[-1].coef_)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Fit a scaled Ridge(alpha=a) on all data for each alpha and take the coefficient norm.
Use KFold(n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) and negate the scores.
Return search.best_estimator_, which GridSearchCV refits on all data.
Alphas must be a non-empty list of positive numbers.
